title: 第12章 抢人头！！！

content_zh:
事情发生的太快，江枫已经完全反应不过来，呆呆的看着本来要杀自己的江琴却突然转手偷袭了邀月，而本该被江琴蒙骗的大哥，却对他大加赞赏……
这世界变化太快，他实在有些接受不能了！
“二弟你毋要惊慌，待得我杀了这贱人，自然会跟你解释一切！”
燕南天高喝一声，得势不饶人，手中铁剑一剑快似一剑，体内嫁衣神功功力如烈火炙热，暴虐无双，哪怕以邀月的移花接玉，也根本转移不得，一时间被逼迫的节节败退！
而在她的腰后……
被碧血照丹青刺伤的创口，仍然在鲜血淋漓。
面对燕南天的咄咄逼人，邀月被逼的根本找不到闲暇止血……而面对嫁衣神功那疯狂的反扑，明玉功纵然可如磁石吸附他人功力，但以嫁衣神功的威能，竟然一时间也被压制的根本无法将他的功力吸转！
一旦有心反扑。
背后伤势便会立时加剧，鲜血喷洒，更伴随着阵阵的刺痛……
邀月自恃功力不下燕南天，结果，竟然完全不是他的对手！
江枫虽然不知道发生什么事情，但眼见大哥占据了绝对的上风，他喝道：“大哥，快杀了这贱人！”
“哈哈哈哈……”
苏景挣扎着从地上爬了起来，脸色早已经疼的煞白，邀月的明玉真气阴寒刺骨，不仅将自己的右手骨头尽数搅碎，更将真气也留在了自己体内，其痛苦，更胜之前被乱筋错玉手折磨的时候！
挣扎了半天，他才终于算是爬了起来，看江枫脸露狂喜神色，显然，他早已经心存死志，但若能死前看到这个恶魔死去，也是人生一大快事！
但苏景却知道，燕南天固然占尽了上风，但若他百招之内不能获胜，恐怕便危险了！
但纵然邀月提前被自己重伤，百招之内……燕南天能获胜吗？
至多一半的机率吧？
但我要的，可是绝对的胜算！
没想到邀月反应竟然这么快，碧血照丹青才刚刚刺进三寸，她便反应过来，之后体内便仿佛有东西在把剑往外顶，不然倘若剑刃彻底进入她的身体的话，恐怕纵然是邀月，也非得毙命不可！
但现在……他仔细观察两人非战斗，急切的想要争取更多的胜机……

突然，眼神一凛，脸上露出了得意神色！
“邀月！没想到你会被我耍了吧？”
苏景哈哈笑了起来，目光在她身上掠过，突然眼睛一亮，高声道：“哈哈哈哈……邀月啊邀月，刚刚看燕大侠杀花月奴是不是看的很过瘾啊？”
可不是么？
苏景又大声道：“总不至于是之前小解的时候不小心洒到裙子上了？公子，您看呐，堂堂移花宫主邀月，竟然也会小便失~禁尿了裤子！”
邀月心头一震，她本毫不在意苏景之前的话，反正片刻之后不过是个死人而已，但他却让江枫去看……
江枫……
一想到自己如今的窘态会被江枫看去。
邀月心头便一阵难以抑制的羞涩和恼怒！
当下手上不自觉乱了几分，燕南天趁隙而上……
邀月一个不慎，低叫一声，腰间已经中了一剑！
鲜血淋漓中……更有刺啦一声响，衣袂已经被生生被那锈剑给撕下来一大块，当下，没了外衫遮拦，腿上那痕迹更重了！
邀月愤怒的尖叫起来，“你们所有人，都要死啊！”
堂堂移花宫主，却被人误会小解到了裙子上，若传出去……江湖上，会怎么看她移花宫？会怎么看她？
当下，她双眼瞬间变的赤红，之前还是攻少守多，瞬息之间，招招尽是攻势，较之之前，凌厉了何止数倍？！
燕南天却突的犹豫起来。
他本是笑傲天下的大侠，何时做过这种欺压妇孺的事情？
乘人之危已是不该，如今若再以女子的名节为攻的话……
他忍不住犹豫了片刻，但回头看了一眼已经重伤垂死的二弟，还有那个义薄云天的小兄弟！
两人皆已重伤，若自己不能斩杀这邀月的话……

但这一犹豫间，他好不容易争得的上风，已经直接被彻底的夺了回去，甚至于有落入下风的迹象！
“受死吧，邀月！”
苏景突然高声叫道：“大爷，你手中不过凡铁，根本伤不得这妖女，我这里有碧血照丹青，乃是这妖女亲手相赠于我的，正可用来杀她！”
说着，他拼死鼓起力气，信手抛起一物，向着燕南天而去！
“好！”
燕南天高喝一声，纵身向着天空跃去，去接苏景丢过来的神兵！

content_en:
Things happened so fast that Jiang Feng couldn't react at all. He stared blankly at Jiang Qin, who was about to kill him, but suddenly turned around and attacked Yao Yue. However, the elder brother who was supposed to be deceived by Jiang Qin praised him greatly...
The world is changing too fast, and he really can't accept it!
"Second brother, don't panic. Wait until I kill this bitch and I will explain everything to you!"
Yan Nantian shouted loudly and showed no mercy. The iron sword in his hand was as fast as a sword. The wedding magic skill in his body was as hot as a blazing fire. He was unparalleled in violence. Even with Yao Yue's method of transferring flowers and jade, he could not move at all. He was forced to retreat steadily!
And behind her waist...
The wound stabbed by Bixuezhao Danqing was still dripping with blood.
Faced with Yan Nantian's aggressiveness, Yao Yue was so forced that she couldn't find any time to stop the bleeding... And faced with the crazy counterattack of the Wedding Clothes Divine Art, even though Mingyu Gong was like a magnet to absorb other people's skills, the power of the Wedding Clothes Divine Art was suppressed for a while and was unable to absorb his skills at all!
Once you have the intention to fight back.
The injuries on the back will immediately intensify, with blood spurting out and accompanied by bursts of stinging pain...
Yao Yue believed that her skills were not inferior to Yan Nantian, but in the end, she was no match for him!
Although Jiang Feng didn't know what was going on, seeing that his elder brother had the absolute upper hand, he shouted: "Brother, kill this bitch quickly!"
"Hahahaha..."
Su Jing struggled to get up from the ground, his face already pale with pain. Yao Yue's Mingyu Qi was so cold and bone-chilling that it not only shattered all the bones in his right hand, but also left the Qi inside his body. The pain was even worse than when he was tortured by the jade hand's chaotic tendons!
After struggling for a long time, he finally got up. Seeing the ecstatic expression on Jiang Feng's face, it was obvious that he had already been determined to die, but if he could see this demon die before he died, it would be a great joy in life!
But Su Jing knew that although Yan Nantian had the upper hand, if he couldn't win within a hundred moves, he might be in danger!
But even if Yao Yue is seriously injured by him in advance, within a hundred moves...can Yan Nantian win?
At most half the chance, right?
But what I want is an absolute chance of winning!
Unexpectedly, Yao Yue reacted so quickly. Bi Xue Zhao Dan Qing had just penetrated three inches before she reacted. Then something inside her body seemed to be pushing the sword outward. Otherwise, if the sword blade completely entered her body, even Yao Yue would have to die!
But now... he carefully observed the two men fighting, eager to gain more chances of victory...
Suddenly, his eyes flashed, and his face showed a proud look!
"Yao Yue! I didn't expect you to be tricked by me, did you?"
Su Jing laughed loudly, his eyes swept over her body, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he said loudly: "Hahahaha... Yao Yue, Yao Yue, did you enjoy watching Hero Yan kill Hua Yue Nu just now?"
Isn't it?
Su Jing said loudly: "Isn't it possible that I accidentally spilled it on my skirt when I was urinating? Young Master, look at it, the dignified Lord of Yihua Palace, Yaoyue, can actually lose urine~he can't stop peeing in his pants!"
Yao Yue's heart was shocked. She didn't care what Su Jing said before. Anyway, he would be just a dead person after a while, but he asked Jiang Feng to see...
Jiang Feng...
When he thought about his current embarrassment, Jiang Feng would look at him.
Yao Yue felt an uncontrollable shyness and anger in her heart!
At that moment, his hands were a little messy unconsciously, and Yan Nantian took advantage of the opportunity to step forward...
Yao Yue accidentally screamed and was hit by a sword in her waist!
There was blood dripping... there was a stabbing sound, and a large piece of his clothes had been torn off by the rusty sword. At that moment, without the outer clothes to cover it, the marks on his legs were even heavier!
Yao Yue screamed angrily, "All of you are going to die!"
The majestic Master of Yihua Palace was misunderstood and her urine leaked onto her skirt. If word spread... what would the world think of Yihua Palace? meetingWhat do you think of her?
At that moment, her eyes instantly turned red. Before, she was less offensive and more defensive. In an instant, her moves were all offensive. They were many times more powerful than before. !
Yan Nantian suddenly hesitated.
He was a hero who was proud of the world, but when had he ever done such a thing of oppressing women and children?
It is no longer right to take advantage of others' danger, but now if a woman's honor and integrity are used as an attack...
He couldn't help but hesitate for a moment, but then he looked back at his second brother who was seriously injured and dying, and the righteous little brother!
Both of them have been seriously injured. If I can't kill Yaoyue...
But during this hesitation, the advantage he had finally gained has been completely taken away, and there are even signs of falling into a disadvantage!
"Suffer death, Yaoyue!"
Su Jing suddenly shouted loudly: "Uncle, your hands are nothing but ordinary iron, and you can't hurt this demon girl at all. I have the blue blood here, which was given to me by the demon girl with her own hands, so I can use it to kill her!"
As he spoke, he mustered up all his strength, threw an object at random, and headed towards Yan Nantian!
"Okay!"
Yan Nantian shouted loudly and jumped into the sky to catch the magic weapon that Su Jing threw over!
